description: Test file containing unit tests for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, verifying string parsing and manipulation functionalities within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, supporting various string operations.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment, based on specified delimiters.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between TextFragment instances or between a TextFragment and a character buffer.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between TextFragment instances or a TextFragment and a character buffer.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the position of a delimiter in the text fragment starting from the beginning.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the content of the TextFragment.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment contains a specific marker.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Checks if the fragment’s text equals a given string.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims the beginning of the fragment if it matches the specified string.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims the end of the fragment if it matches the specified string.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the position of a substring from the end.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards in the text to find a specific substring.
